UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private user account identity and PII isolated from public leaderboard records.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when account was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when account was last updated.

MinerProfile.title: MinerProfile
MinerProfile.description: Public miner state, upgrade levels, and leaderboard ranking entry without PII.

piHandle.description: Public Pi Network pioneer handle shown on the leaderboard.

displayName.description: Public display name shown on the leaderboard.

isPublic.description: Controls public visibility on the global mainnet leaderboard.

totalMined.description: Lifetime total Pi coins mined for global leaderboard ranking.

passiveLevel.description: Node Validator Rig passive rate upgrade level.

lastCollectAt.description: Timestamp of last passive mining collection.

lastQuizDate.description: UTC date string (YYYY-MM-DD) of the most recent completed daily quiz.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when miner profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when miner profile was last updated.

QuizAttempt.title: QuizAttempt
QuizAttempt.description: Immutable daily crypto quiz completion record for a specific UTC date.

dateKey.description: UTC date key in YYYY-MM-DD format.

totalQuestions.description: Total number of questions in the daily set.

coinsEarned.description: Total bonus Pi coins earned from this daily quiz.

status.description: Terminal completion state for the daily quiz attempt.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the daily quiz was completed.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user account records containing email PII, accessible only to the owning user.

/users/{userId}/quiz_attempts/{dateId}.description: Daily quiz completion records keyed by UTC YYYY-MM-DD date, created once per day.

/leaderboard/{userId}.description: Public miner state and global leaderboard ranking entries without any PII.
